rows.quest:1654:details:1: I will craft for you a weapon worthy of what you've accomplished, a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, but you must gather the items I need to craft it. I've already started taking notes on the items, it just requires someone brave and skilled enough to recover them. What do you say, ⟦66⟧?
rows.quest:1654:progress:0: The items you're seeking will be difficult to acquire, but I can assure you, the weapon I will craft for you will be worth the effort.⟦67⟧⟦68⟧It will be my finest work to date, and only a small payment for the service you've done me.
rows.quest:1654:completion:0: This is wonderful! You've gotten all the items.
rows.quest:1654:completion:1: I should have no problem forging you a grand weapon with these. I've actually had the plans for doing this for some time. I just never had the opportunity to gather the goods. Thank you, ⟦69⟧.
rows.quest:1654:completion:2: It feels good to have my father's hammer again...and a Kor gem. I never thought I'd see one of these myself.
rows.quest:1806:obj:0: Wait for ⟦E44⟧ to finish forging a weapon for you.
rows.quest:1806:details:0: Why don't we go over to the forge and get started on this? I've been preparing for your arrival for some time, so it shouldn't take long at all.
rows.quest:1806:details:1: When we're done, you'll be far more prepared to defend the Light than you have been, this much I swear.
rows.quest:1806:details:2: I'll be somewhat honest, ⟦70⟧, seeing the results of your exploits makes me somewhat envious. But knowing that I can contribute to your adventures in my own significant way does bring me some joy.
rows.quest:1806:completion:0: Here it is, ⟦71⟧. A weapon worthy of a champion of the Light such as yourself. I've named it after a great dwarven paladin who was a friend of mine. His name was Verigan... Bosch Verigan.
rows.quest:1806:completion:1: Please take it on behalf of myself and my wife. We owe you a great debt, and the world will be a safer place with one of your skill traveling the land.
rows.quest:1650:details:0: Good! Your lack of hesitation is a sure sign that you are prepared and eager to test yourself. So be it.
rows.quest:1650:details:1: At the very ends of ⟦E50⟧'s Longshore, a small house overlooks the ocean. There, a couple lives, the Stilwells. Jordan is an incredible smith, and he's gone to ⟦E20⟧ to meet with the dwarves for a while. But this has left Daphne, his wife, alone and unprotected.
rows.quest:1650:details:2: Reports suggest that the Defias have all but taken over the area, Daphne may need some protection from the villains. Go there.
rows.quest:1650:completion:0: Hello, ⟦72⟧. I'm assuming by all that armor and weapon of yours, you're either here to try and take my land, or the Church finally sent someone to help protect me while my Jordan's gone.
rows.quest:1650:completion:1: B Well, let me introduce myself: I'm ⟦E49⟧. It's a pleasure.
rows.quest:1650:completion:2: Now, you're not too late... I've only killed a half dozen of the scum since last sun up. They've been a little slow getting 'round the bend up there, but they probably saw you coming, which means they'll probably be here any minute.
rows.quest:1651:obj:1: Neither of your spirits must be released from their mortal coils if you wish to succeed.
rows.quest:1651:obj:2: After you are successful, speak to ⟦E49⟧ again.
rows.quest:1651:details:0: Now, they'll be coming again soon, I'd wager, so get yourself ready.
rows.quest:1651:details:1: I've got myself a gun in the house. I'll grab it and be ready to help you out, but for the most part, you're on your own.
rows.quest:1651:details:2: I've no idea how many they'll send, but I'm sure it'll be more than the few they sent earlier.
rows.quest:1651:details:3: Ask the Light for whatever blessings you can because... did you hear that? I think they're coming.
rows.quest:1651:details:4: We make our stand near the house!
rows.quest:1651:progress:0: We'll make our stand at the house!
rows.quest:1651:completion:0: We've done it, ⟦73⟧! Thank you for your help. You were truly amazing out there. I never thought a ⟦74⟧ could handle so many enemies at once.
rows.quest:1651:completion:1: You've truly shown bravery in the face of overwhelming odds.
rows.quest:1652:details:0: Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. I have you and the Church to thank for that.
rows.quest:1652:details:1: He'll send word to ⟦E20⟧ to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.
rows.quest:1652:details:2: Oh, how I miss my husband. I can't wait till he returns.
rows.quest:1652:completion:0: So, we meet again, ⟦75⟧, and you are in high spirits, I see.
rows.quest:1652:completion:1: The Stilwell home will be safe for another day, and from your story I see that there was no shortage of danger to be found. Well done.
rows.quest:1652:completion:2: Daphne and Jordan have helped the Church greatly, and having you protect their property--and their very lives--was the least we could do for them.
rows.quest:1652:completion:3: For your valor, you will be rewarded.
